LING SUMMARY : Bit was run to bottom and trip gas of 0.17% was circulated at 2035m. The last few stands were washed to bottom. Continual dumping of the shaker box and the diluting of the active pit helped to reduce the continuing gumbo problems. These problems continued with the eventual blocking of the flow line. Both booster pump and mudcleaner were run to try and reduce the gumbo problem. Gas values were very low,
